stem:
Priya writes the word MOM on a piece of paper and holds it in front of a plane mirror in her bedroom.
How does the word appear in the mirror?

options.text: MOM, exactly as it is written
MOM, but with each letter reversed left to right
WOW, with each letter reversed left to right

teacher.key_rationale: A plane mirror produces lateral inversion: left and right swap, so each letter appears reversed left to right; the word is not turned upside down and is not shown unchanged. The letters M, O, M happen to look the same when reversed, but option C is the only statement describing the lateral-inversion effect; A wrongly claims no change, B wrongly claims top-bottom inversion, D combines both errors.
